prompt.task: Registration result assessment: ACCEPT / RETRY / ABORT

probe_observations.ambiguity_reason: near_line_degeneracy (λ1≈λ2; transverse axes undetermined); near_line_degeneracy (λ1≈λ2; transverse axes undetermined)
probe_observations.note: 主轴结构不稳定；不得将 rotation_estimate_deg 用于算法选择。

_probe_request.probe_reason: The critical gap is rotation magnitude, which PCA_ORIENTATION directly addresses by comparing PCA principal frames to estimate coarse relative rotation and anisotropy at <1 ms cost. CHEAP_LOCAL_ICP would only confirm whether identity-init is in a good local convergence basin but would not resolve the rotation uncertainty, so PCA is the higher-value first probe.

probe_observations.note: initial_* 为 identity 初值 1 次迭代近似 baseline；probe 固定 5 次迭代，无 Global 初始化，无 SOR。 结果只作观察信息，不直接映射算法。

_probe_request.probe_reason: PCA was inconclusive (LOW confidence, null rotation). A cheap local ICP probe from the available initial pose will reveal how much the pose is actually off: strong fitness/rmse indicates rotation is small and LOCAL_ICP is viable; weak result signals large misalignment, favoring a global method. This is the decisive information PCA could not provide.

guardrail_reference.note: Guardrail only sets a minimum acceptable quality floor and retry limit; the professional judgment of ACCEPT/RETRY/ABORT is yours.

output_schema.assessment: string (short professional assessment of result quality)

notes: Do NOT read GT transform or rotation/translation error in your assessment.
ACCEPT: result quality is sufficient for the task.
RETRY: result is below acceptable quality but there is a plausible retry path.
ABORT: no reasonable path to a better result; stop.
